title: Accordion Component
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `Accordion` that takes a prop `sections` (array of `{ title: string, content: string }`). Render each section with a clickable title. Clicking a title toggles its content visibility. Only one section can be open at a time. If the open section's title is clicked, it closes. Add `data-testid="section-{index}"` to each section wrapper.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useState`
- Default export
- Props: `sections` (array of `{ title, content }`)
- Only one section open at a time
- Clicking open section closes it
- data-testid="section-{index}" on each wrapper

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: Only one section open at a time
